title: Water, irrigation and their connection to state power in Egypt
version: Draft of 18 February 2012 for a conference, hosted by Yale University

passages.quote: Such artificial irrigation of the fields is attested at the every beginning of unified Egyptian history (The so-called “Scorpion Macehead” depicting the king clearing a canal ca. 3100 BC)
